assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent botanical portrait for a premium native Mac app called Bonsai. A single miniature bonsai tree in a shallow ceramic pot, centered, entire tree and pot visible with generous transparent margins. Elegant detailed 3D illustration, sculptural curved trunk and asymmetrical canopy, soft luminous lighting, refined Japanese botanical mood, softly textured foliage, plausible botanical structure, subtle painterly realism. Square composition. No text, no scene, no ground, no shadow beyond pot, no extra objects, no frame, no watermark. Genuinely transparent background. Tree fills roughly 80% of image height. Pot rim at 82% image height. Colors remain readable on ivory and charcoal backgrounds. Subject: flowering Japanese cherry blossom bonsai, delicate blush pink petals with a few mint green leaves, aged warm brown trunk, warm ivory ceramic oval pot. Airy elegant canopy, softly lit petals, no detached falling petals.
